22085-sir-jagadis-chunder-bose-his-life-.title: Sir Jagadis Chunder Bose His Life And Speeches
22085-sir-jagadis-chunder-bose-his-life-.creator: Unknown
22085-sir-jagadis-chunder-bose-his-life-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. On the 30th November, 1858, Jagadis Chunder was born, in a respectable Hindu family, which hails from village Rarikhal, situated in the Vikrampur Pargana of the Dacca District, in Bengal. He passed his boyhood at Faridpur, where his father, the late Babu Bhugwan Chunder Bose, a member of the _then_ Subordinate Executive Service was the Sub-Divisional Officer; and it was there that he derived "the power and strength that nerved him to meet the shocks of life."[1]

6618-poems-of-purpose.title: Poems Of Purpose
6618-poems-of-purpose.creator: Ella Wheeler Wilcox
6618-poems-of-purpose.description: A book by Ella Wheeler Wilcox. d I heard the older men talking of the road to wealth; They talked of bulls and bears, of buying on margins, And they said, ‘Be a sport, my boy, plunge in and win or lose it all! It is the only way to fortune.

arxiv-1401-3949.title: Parallel Texture Structures with Cofactor Zeros in Lepton Sector
arxiv-1401-3949.creator: Weijian Wang
arxiv-1401-3949.description: Abstract In this paper we investigate the parallel texture structures with cofactor zeros in the charged lepton and neutrino sectors. The textures can not be obtained from arbitrary leptonic matrices by making weak basis transformations, which therefore have physical meaning. The 15 parallel textures are grouped as 4 classes where each class has the same physical implications.

arxiv-2310-11467.title: Enhancing Binary Code Comment Quality Classification: Integrating Generative AI for Improved Accuracy
arxiv-2310-11467.creator: Rohith Arumugam S, Angel Deborah S
arxiv-2310-11467.description: Abstract This report focuses on enhancing a binary code comment quality classification model by integrating generated code and comment pairs, to improve model accuracy. The dataset comprises 9048 pairs of code and comments written in the C programming language, each annotated as ”Useful” or ”Not Useful.

arxiv-2405-01629.title: A hidden population of active galactic nuclei can explain the overabundance of luminous 𝒛 > 𝟏𝟎 z>10 objects observed by JWST
arxiv-2405-01629.creator: Sahil Hegde, Michael M. Wyatt, and Steven R. Furlanetto
arxiv-2405-01629.description: Abstract The first wave of observations with JWST has revealed a striking overabundance of luminous galaxies at early times ( z > 10 z>10 ) compared to models of galaxies calibrated to pre-JWST data. Early observations have also uncovered a large population of supermassive black holes (SMBHs) at z > 6 z>6 .

The US government retains and the publisher, by accepting the work for publication, acknowledges
arxiv-2503-06322.creator: Jieyang Chen ∗ , Qian Gong ⋄ , Yanliang Li ∗ , Xin Liang † , Lipeng Wan ‡ , Qing Liu △ , Norbert Podhorszki ⋄ , Scott Klasky ⋄
arxiv-2503-06322.description: Abstract The rapid growth in scientific data generation is outpacing advancements in computing systems necessary for efficient storage, transfer, and analysis, particularly in the context of exascale computing. With the deployment of first-generation exascale computing systems and next-generation experimental facilities, this gap is widening and necessitates effective data reduction techniques to manage enormous data volumes.

arxiv-2505-09152.title: Nelson-Aalen kernel estimator to the tail index
arxiv-2505-09152.creator: of right censored Pareto-type data
arxiv-2505-09152.description: Abstract On the basis of Nelson-Aalen product-limit estimator of a randomly right censored distribution function, we introduce a kernel estimator to the tail index of right censored Pareto-like data. Under some regularity assumptions, the consistency and asymptotic normality of the proposed estimator are established.

arxiv-2505-20706.title: The Quasar-associated 2175 Å Dust Absorbers in the SDSS DR16 Quasar Catalog
arxiv-2505-20706.creator: Shaohua Zhang, Yuchong Luo, Shangchun Xie, Chao Gao, Zhijian Luo, Chenggang Shu, Hubing Xiao
arxiv-2505-20706.description: Abstract We present, for the first time, a systematic study of quasar-associated 2175 Å dust absorbers using spectroscopic data from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) Data Release 16 (DR16). By analyzing the optical spectra and multi-band magnitudes of 557,674 quasars in the redshift range of 0.7 ≤ z ≤ 2.4 0.7\leq z\leq 2.

arxiv-2507-07105.title: 4 K A g e n t : Agentic Any Image to 4K Super-Resolution
arxiv-2507-07105.creator: Yushen Zuo, Qi Zheng, Mingyang Wu, Xinrui Jiang, Renjie Li, Jian Wang, Yide Zhang, Gengchen Mai, Lihong V. Wang, James Zou, Xiaoyu Wang, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Zhengzhong Tu, [2pt] Texas A&M University, [2pt] Corresponding Author: tzz@tamu.edu . Equal contributions.[2pt] Project Website : 4kagent.github.i
arxiv-2507-07105.description: Abstract We present 4KAgent , a unified agentic super-resolution generalist system designed to universally upscale any image to 4K resolution (and even higher, if applied iteratively). Our system can transform images from extremely low resolutions with severe degradations, for example, highly distorted inputs at 256 × 256 256\times 256 , into crystal-clear, photorealistic 4K outputs.

arxiv-2507-11278.title: The fault in our sirens: Hierarchical diagnosis of waveform systematics in Hubble-Lemaître–constant measurements
arxiv-2507-11278.creator: Arnab Dhani, Jonathan Gair, Alessandra Buonanno
arxiv-2507-11278.description: Abstract Cosmological inference using a population of binary black-hole mergers, combined with a galaxy catalog, presents an exciting opportunity for precision cosmology with the possibility of resolving the Hubble tension. However, the accuracy of these measurements heavily relies on the quality of the model used to infer the binary parameters, including the model of the gravitational-wave signal.

pmc-11418520.title: Acustimulation combined with pharmacological prophylaxis versus pharmacological prophylaxis alone in postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV) prophylaxis among patients undergoing laparoscopy abdominal surgery: a research protocol for a randomised controlled trial
pmc-11418520.creator: Junjie Chen, Lu Che, Quexuan Cui, Jiaxin Lang, Yuelun Zhang, Bo Zhu, Yuguang Huang
pmc-11418520.description: IntroductionThis study evaluates the efficacy of integrating percutaneous electrical nerve stimulation at the pericardium 6 (PC6) acupuncture point through a wearable acustimulation device with standard pharmacological prophylaxis to prevent postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV) compared with pharmacological prophylaxis alone in patients undergoing laparoscopic abdominal surgery.Method and analysisThis prospective study will enrol 302 patients scheduled for elective laparoscopic surgery.

pmc-12541948.title: Comparing all-suture repair versus tension band wiring fixation in patellar fractures
pmc-12541948.creator: Teddy Cheong, Hon Keng Pui Bryan, Lee Bing Howe, Wong Merng Koon, Eric Wei Liang Cher
pmc-12541948.description: IntroductionImplant-related issues necessitating removal are well reported in tension band wiring (TBW) of patellar fractures. Suture materials can minimize complications associated with TBW fixation but there is a paucity of literature on all-suture fixation outcomes. This study aims to compare outcomes between all-suture versus TBW fixation of patellar fractures.

pmc-12555985.title: Differences in Cortisol Profiles of Students according to School Schedule
pmc-12555985.creator: D Gabaldón-Estevan, D Carmona-Talavera, C Ferreros-García, I Obregon-Aristimuño, C Valero Hernández, N Estany, G Sáez
pmc-12555985.description: BackgroundMatching school schedules to students’ attention spans positively impacts students’ health and performance. Cortisol measurement is a recurrent procedure to assess both the chronotype profile and to evaluate attention. Students circadian profile evolves as they age but often schools’ schedules ignore this fact. This research maps students cortisol profile across the week and school schedule.

pmc-12656127.title: A ZIF-8-Based High-Performance Glucose Electrochemical Detection Platform Constructed Using a Multi-Layer Interface Optimization Strategy
pmc-12656127.creator: Canjie Hu, Pengjia Qi, Lichao Liu, Yang Chen, Jijun Tong
pmc-12656127.description: Highlights What are the main findings? A high-performance glucose biosensor was fabricated using a multilayered MWCNTs/PB/ZIF-8@GOx/CS composite.The sensor achieved rapid response, wide linear range, high sensitivity, ultra-low detection limit, and excellent operational stability. What are the implications of the main findings? The developed sensor shows strong potential for real-time and accurate clinical glucose monitoring.

pmc-12835001.title: Enhancing healthcare classification with hybrid multimedia data processing and deep learning TNBO FCNN approach in IoT-enabled environments
pmc-12835001.creator: Leeladhar Chourasiya, Umesh Kumar Lillohre, Abhishek Kumar Pandey, Sarita Simaiya, Shimaa A. Hussien, Ehab Seif Ghith, Monish Khan
pmc-12835001.description: The rapid expansion of IoT-based healthcare systems has led to an explosion of multimodal patient data (e.g., voice, images, signals), raising concerns about accurate classification, real-time processing, and data security. Existing machine learning approaches often suffer from limited feature extraction, high computational demands, and inadequate privacy protection, particularly in decentralised and resource-constrained environments.

pmc-13068613.title: Spice essential oils as natural preservatives in processed sausages: a systematic review of their physicochemical, antimicrobial, antioxidant, and sensory effects
pmc-13068613.creator: Aref Adeli Mosabbeb, Negin Majdi, Soheyl Eskandari, Saeedeh Shojaee-Aliabadi
pmc-13068613.description: ObjectiveThe increasing demand for natural, safe, and high-quality meat products has prompted interest in replacing synthetic preservatives with plant-based alternatives. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the effects of spice essential oils (SEOs) on the physicochemical, antimicrobial, antioxidant, and sensory properties of processed sausages.

pmc-13071592.title: Female pulmonologists experienced poorer health and reduced quality of life related to their professional activities
pmc-13071592.creator: Claire Leloup, Emilie Mesa, Damien Basille, Augustin Boudoussier, Arnaud Maurac, Léo Grassion, Camille Rolland-Debord, Iban Larrouture, Clémence Martin, Florence Jeny, Thomas Maitre, Maxime Patout, Lucile Sese, Thibaud Soumagne, Thomas Gille, Grégoire Justeau, Hélène Salvator, Jonathan Messika, Etie
pmc-13071592.description: BackgroundDespite increasing gender parity in medical school enrolment, disparities in career progression and physician well-being persist. This study evaluated professional experiences, health status and perceived gender-related barriers among pulmonologists in France.MethodsA nationwide, anonymous cross-sectional survey (546-item) was distributed to all French pulmonologists between July 2023 and February 2024. Data included work-related health disorders, career paths and gender perceptions.

pmc-13159225.title: Efficacy and safety of cannabidiol (CBD) on reducing pain and functional impairment associated with exercise-induced muscle injury: a randomized placebo-controlled feasibility trial
pmc-13159225.creator: JW Stauffer, JA Crow, MD Bishop, RL Cook, PA Borsa
pmc-13159225.description: BackgroundExercise and sports-related musculoskeletal injuries often result in pain, and the recovery process can be prolonged and challenging. Many physically-active Americans have begun using cannabidiol (CBD) for pain relief and improved recovery time, and CBD is of particular interest due to its positive safety profile, non-intoxicating effects, and therapeutic potential. Our objectives were threefold.

pmc-13254362.title: Unified multimodal learning for stroke triage: joint detection, scoring, and segmentation of acute ischemic stroke
pmc-13254362.creator: Tengfei Luan, Dianbei Wang, Song Hu, Wenyu Zhou, Ziyang Wang, Qiao Li, Pengcheng Liu, Gao Wu, Meihua Wang, Weijun Huang, Faqiang Zhang, Hao Yang
pmc-13254362.description: Timely and accurate triage of acute ischemic stroke patients remains a critical challenge in clinical practice, particularly across heterogeneous imaging protocols and multicenter settings. Existing approaches often focus on isolated tasks such as large-vessel occlusion detection, collateral scoring, or infarct segmentation, leading to fragmented pipelines with limited generalizability and increased latency.

pmc-13448116.title: Response Letter: Reconsidering Intraoperative Hip Positioning in Single-Position Lateral Lumbar Interbody Fusion – A Commentary on “Optimal Positioning for Single-Position Lateral Lumbar Interbody Fusion”
pmc-13448116.creator: Worawat Limthongkul, Natavut Prasertkul, Pakawas Praisarnti, Maruay Tanayavong, Surachat Jaroenwareekul, Wicharn Yingsakmongkol, Weerasak Singhatanadgige, Vit Kotheeranurak

pmc-13476333.title: The umbilical canal revisited: historical anatomy and radiologic implications of a commonly misnamed CT finding
pmc-13476333.creator: André Vaz, Vinícius Cardoso Serra, Camila Pietroski Reifegerste
pmc-13476333.description: BackgroundThe increasing use of cross-sectional imaging—particularly abdominal computed tomography (CT)—together with the global rise in obesity has brought renewed attention to a fat-containing structure posterior to the umbilical scar that is frequently labeled as an “umbilical hernia” in radiology reports.

uslaw-usc-t15-s2664.title: 15 U.S.C. § 2664 — Model construction standards and techniques
uslaw-usc-t15-s2664.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s2664.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 53 (Toxic Substances Control); Subchapter III (Indoor Radon Abatement). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency shall develop model construction standards and techniques for controlling radon levels within new buildings. To the maximum extent possible, these standards and techniques should be developed with the assistance of organizations involved.
